fields.reasoning: The flake is a race between two guide.install runs of the same binary. Install A writes plugin.json first, then SKILL.md and the rest. Install B can stat the folder between those writes, see no plugin.json, find SKILL.md, and call the folder foreign. pluginForeign's comment already says a folder created by another install with no plugin.json yet should not be foreign, so the code intends this case and only misses it when a sibling file exists. Comparing the other files to pluginFiles(ctx.Version) keeps the real protection: a folder with a different SKILL.md or hooks file is still a conflict unless --force. Alternatives I weighed: writing plugin.json last (still racy, since the sibling-file check would still fire), and a lock file or flock around the install (new mechanism for a one-binary race). The fix stays inside guide_install.go and needs no change to the test.
fields.statement: pluginForeign treats a folder with no plugin.json as foreign only when one of its other plugin files holds bytes this rhiza would not write; a folder whose files all match this rhiza's own output is a racing install's partial write and is not foreign. The install keeps writing plugin.json first and does not loosen the test.
